corridors.name: La Guaira ↔ Caraballeda
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Coastal run east from La Guaira port to the Caraballeda marina, offshore of the breakwaters.

corridors.name: La Guaira ↔ Los Roques (candidate)
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Open Caribbean crossing ~80nm north to the Los Roques archipelago; beyond Pioneer range — roadmap Quanta-LR; no land crossing.

corridors.name: Maracaibo ↔ Cabimas
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Open crossing of Lake Maracaibo; pass under the Rafael Urdaneta bridge span; no land crossing.

vessel_gate_rule: <=70nm Pioneer II solid; 75-150nm Quanta-LR amber-dashed; >150nm review
_vessel_gate_note: Range-gated by hull. Long legs never faked on a 70nm boat.
